description: Use this when the user asks for a cheaper option, an alternative, or the same product from another store. Returns cheaper listings that have our own price history: first the same product sold by other stores (relation same_product_other_shop), then products with a similar title in the same category (relation similar_product, not necessarily the same item). Each one has its price difference and its own verdict and certainty. Every product carries pageUrl (the DipScout page with the price chart: the citation link), buyUrl (affiliate link through DipScout, disclosed in `monetization`; the price is the same with or without it), summary and citation (a self-contained sentence measured from our price history) and verdict (the short answer to "is this a good price?").

idioma.description: Optional language for the human-readable text (title, discount.explanation, discount.warning, pageUrl): "en" (default), "de", "pt", "es" or "fr". Field names, numbers and currency (USD) are the same in every language.

mercado.description: "us": only US listings, which ship within the United States only. "global": only listings that ship worldwide. Omit for both. For a shopper outside the US, use "global". Prices are always the ones read for the US.

produto.description: The AliExpress product URL exactly as the user pasted it (any country or language subdomain: www.aliexpress.com, pt.aliexpress.com, aliexpress.us, aliexpress.ru, m.aliexpress.com, /item/<id>.html, /i/<id>.html, ?productId=<id>), the short link the AliExpress app's Share button copies (a.aliexpress.com/_..., s.click.aliexpress.com/e/_..., even inside the shared sentence), a DipScout product URL, or the numeric product id.
